title: Add Page Numbers to PDF – Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Add page numbers to a PDF in your browser: 1, 1 / N or Page 1 of N, Western or Arabic-Indic digits, any position. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Add Page Numbers to PDF
subtitle: Number the pages of a PDF as 1, 1 / N or Page 1 of N, in Western or Arabic-Indic digits; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Add page numbers to a PDF online: choose where they go, the first number and the format, 1, 1 / N or Page 1 of N, in Western or Arabic-Indic digits, and skip the cover page if you like. A live preview shows the result before you save, and the PDF is numbered in your browser, so nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: The numbers are drawn on your PDF by your own browser. The file is never sent to a server.

features.title: Free with no limits
features.text: No account, no watermark and no cap on pages or files.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, numbering keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How to add page numbers to a PDF

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Pick how the numbers look
steps.text: Choose the position, format, digits, size and first number, and whether to skip the first page. The preview shows the result.

steps.title: Add numbers and download
steps.text: Click Add page numbers, then download the numbered PDF. Nothing leaves your device.

handles: Position: top or bottom; left, centre or right.
Format: 1, 1 / N, or Page 1 of N in the page's language.
Digits: Western (1 2 3) or Arabic-Indic (١ ٢ ٣), and a small, medium or large size.
Pages: every page, or all but the first.
limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be numbered; remove the password first.
Numbers are drawn as small pictures, so they can't be selected or searched.
Numbers are drawn over anything already in that corner of the page.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your PDF is read and numbered by your browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it yourself: open your browser's network panel and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Where can the page numbers go?
faq.answer: At the top or bottom of the page, on the left, in the centre or on the right, as 1, 1 / N or Page 1 of N, in Western (1 2 3) or Arabic-Indic (١ ٢ ٣) digits.

faq.question: Can I start from a number other than 1?
faq.answer: Yes. Type the number of the first page, for example 5 when the PDF continues another document.

faq.question: Can I number a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not directly: a PDF that needs a password to open can't be read by this tool. If you know the password, remove it with Unlock PDF, which also runs in your browser, then add the numbers.

faq.question: Does the rest of my PDF change?
faq.answer: No. Only the numbers are added; text, images and links stay as they were.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I add page numbers to a PDF?
faq.answer: Choose the PDF, pick where the numbers go and how they look, then click Add page numbers and download the numbered file. OpenAnyDoc does this in your browser, so the PDF is never uploaded, and the preview shows the numbers before you save.
